analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 4 consecutive sessions. RSI has moved from 44.0 five days ago to 54.7 currently, exiting oversold territory and consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram has improved from -180.7463 to -34.7006, maintaining a bottom-building signal. Current price ($64,925.47) is above SMA20 ($64,387.47) but below SMA100 ($68,342.68). Consolidating around the Bollinger Band middle line ($64,387.47) indicates a lack of directional momentum. Weekly ADX at 13.7 suggests a non-trending environment. Despite five consecutive daily gains, the volume ratio of 1.07 shows no significant buying pressure. At 10.5% of the 52-week high, the price remains low historically, but medium-to-long-term moving averages (SMA100, SMA200) are acting as resistance. The 4-hour RSI at 65.1 warrants caution for potential overbought conditions. Overall, the absence of clear buy/sell signals necessitates a continued wait-and-see approach.
